Well, Doug Atkins was way before my time. I'm 39, born in '76, so I'm very much a child of the 80's. My first NFL game was in 1983.

But I've always been really interested in stuff that happened in football before my time, and I suppose these posts are an effort to share that feeling. I've looked at it in terms of "What'd I miss?"

My process for choosing a video probably takes longer than it should. What happens is I'll browse v/NFL, and try to get inspired. Who are we talking about this week? Then, as long as it's been a couple days since my last post (I don't want to flood the sub), I'll start looking up old videos. I try to spread the teams out.

In this case, the first power rankings came out and there was a lot of talk about how bad the Bears were. I knew that I hadn't posted anything Chicago recently, so I started looking. Looked up the NFL all-decade teams and tried to find a fun video. The most important qualifiers for me are that the clip is fun and informative. I'm more worried about the content being interesting than I am about the quality of the footage, and I want to keep it to a decent amount of time. Some people might not want to watch a 15 minute video.

Usually I'll wind up looking at 10-20 videos before I settle on my favorite. I might get distracted by some other cool video. If it's a good one I'll file it for later. I already have videos picked out for Memorial Day, Christmas, and New Year's. So a decent amount of thought actually goes into it. And I get to "waste" an hour or two looking at old NFL footage.
